scope: Real synthetic auth, persisted client create/read and current temporary SQLite; only response delivery and named failures are doubled; no generation or providers
checks: Native pointer registration works; modal labels/focus trap and 320/390 scoped axe/responsive checks pass; success closes and clears the form
A held real creation disables duplicate submissions; repeat clicks issue no second POST
Lost response after real creation locks resubmission across modal close/reopen, with a read-only client-list link; persisted client remains reachable
A 404 transport double after a real successful creation never falls back to old form data or enables another creation POST
Explicit 422 transport rejection leaves editable inputs and an actionable error without claiming successful creation
Account switch during a real held POST discards its response before any client GET, clears all sensitive inputs, and closes the modal
A held real client GET after creation also verifies canonical identity; a same-tab account switch without a storage event cannot select previous-account data
Late real client-search results are discarded after canonical account change, with search text/list cleared and no stale select buttons
